patterns_found.name: Double Top
patterns_found.evidence: Two distinct price peaks near 66000 resistance with an intermediate trough around 64500-65000. Price is currently declining from the second peak and testing the neckline area near 64600.

vlm_analysis.visual_evidence: BTC/USDT 15m chart shows price rejected at ~66000 twice, forming a potential double top. Current price 64609.9 is near the neckline support area. Latest candle is still forming and appears bearish.
limitations: Latest 15m candle is not yet closed
Pattern requires neckline break for confirmation
Intraday noise on 15m timeframe may produce false signals
